messages:
Aisha Rahman: hey everyone — Aisha here, joining the infra team today. i brought a small box of sushi (veggie + salmon) and a spare pothos leaf for the plant shelf, will drop both by the kitchen at 12:10 :sushi: :seedling:
Eli Navarro: welcome Aisha! i'll be by at 12:15 to grab a roll and snag a plant cutting. big fan of office greenery :raised_hands:
Zoe Martinez: yum sushi! heads up the fridge has a note about labeling — leave a sticky with ingredients pls. also there's a 12:45 "intro lightning" in the lounge if you want to say hi to the crew.
DevBot: Reminder: New hire meet-and-greet in the lounge at 12:45. Please check in at reception for badges. (automated)
Brett K.: welcome aboard. tiny tip: put your name on the tupperware or it mysteriously vanishes 602
Nina O.: welcome Aisha! if you like low-light plants i can match you with a desk buddy from the shelf. also i have a spare plant saucer if you need one.
Aisha Rahman: thanks all! labeled the box and left allergy notes (contains fish, soy). i60a will swing by the lightning intros and then hang for a quick rooftop sketch if anyone's around :pencil2:
Eli Navarro: see you at 12:45, and strong +1 for rooftop sketches. also there9s usually a small pile of ukulele players on Fridays if you play :notes:
Zoe Martinez: saved you a seat at the lounge table. welcome again :wave:
